summary: Universal Health Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, to report entering into a First Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment adds a $50 million incremental term loan facility, adjusts the minimum tangible net worth requirement to $100 million, and removes the 0.10% Term SOFR Adjustment. A new subsidiary was added as a guarantor. The term loan matures on September 30, 2028, with interest based on SOFR or Base Rate plus a leverage-based margin. This is a routine debt financing modification, not a special situation. Watch for ongoing leverage ratio compliance and any future capital structure changes.
